package_info.package_manager: Standalone/CI-CD tool (not a package manager like npm/PyPI)
package_info.why_malicious: No evidence of malicious behavior. Dastardly is a legitimate web application security scanner developed by PortSwigger, intended to help organizations identify vulnerabilities in their web applications. The report describes new features, bug fixes, and improvements, but does not indicate any malicious code or behavior.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: There is no indication of malicious behavior in the provided report. Dastardly is a legitimate security tool. No detection strategy is required.
